'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Mitch Nieland DS Fear Is My Ally''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mitch Nieland]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Mitch Neland
* '''Deck name:''' Tusken Tea-bag
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
